messages:
ben: Hey team — hitting a weird error on the quickstart. Ran the Node sample and first call returns 403 with JSON: {\"error\":\"workspace_provisioning_required\", \"detail\":\"enable_billing\"}. I'm on a brand new org invited via email.
Alice: Hi @ben — can you paste the exact curl or SDK call (sanitized token) and the workspace id if you have it? Also which quickstart (node/docker) you used?
ben: node quickstart from README, command: curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H \"Authorization: Bearer sk-REDACTED\" -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" -d '{\"model\":\"redwood-1\",\"input\":\"hello\"}'
Alice: Thanks. That error string (workspace_provisioning_required) should only appear for orgs that haven't finished billing setup. Did you sign up through the invite link or did someone add you to an existing org?
ben: I accepted an invite to a new workspace created by our dev lead. I don't see a billing page in the console (or maybe I'm looking in the wrong place).
emma: Quick note — we recently made a guard that marks newly created workspaces as \"provisioning\" when created via invite if there's no billing profile attached. The UX should surface a billing prompt but we discovered a race where the backend returns provisioning instead of billing_required.
carla: Ping from billing — if the org has no payment method and no trial credits, API calls are gated. We log a different error, but looks like the provisioning flag got reused. Can you share the workspace id (ws_...) so I can check on our side?
ben: ws-0a9f3c. I PMed the full id and the invite email.
Alice: In the meantime, quick workaround: create a personal sandbox workspace (console > Create workspace) which automatically has trial credits, then re-run the quickstart with the header `X-Workspace: ws-0a9f3c-sandbox` or set the env var RW_WORKSPACE=ws-0a9f3c-sandbox. If you prefer CLI: `rwctl workspace create --name quickstart-sandbox` then `export RW_WORKSPACE=...`
ben: Trying that now...
ben: OK got a 200 and streaming tokens! Looks like sandbox worked — first successful call. :tada:
emma: Great. I'll file a follow-up to make the console show a clearer billing CTA on invite-created orgs and to unify the error code (should be billing_required).
carla: I checked ws-0a9f3c — it was pending billing acceptance from the owner. I sent an automated email to the owner to add a payment method; also set a temporary flag so team members can use sandbox workspaces until billing is done.
Alice: Filed internal issue DE-742 for the UX + DE-743 for the error mapping. Adding a small note to the quickstart README: if you get workspace_provisioning_required, create a sandbox workspace or ensure the org owner adds a billing method.
ben: Thanks all — was confusing for a new user but the sandbox workaround saved the day. Closing my follow-ups.
dino-bot: [ticket created] DE-742 DE-743 attached to ticket #43890, assigned to emma and Alice.
